name: Zombie Bait
source:
You were just in the mall minding your own business when suddenly, out of nowhere (and rather dramatically) zombies appear.  Is this a deeper conspiracy for the mall to be a ground zero testing ground... or is it just a mere run-of-the-mill coincidence?

Join Tentacles and Slacker (not their real names) and some mysterious grumpy dude to try to figure out if this is the zombie apocalypse rising or something else entirely.

[From Itch.io]
